newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers stage late recovery as Europe weakens.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers stage late recovery as Europe weakens.

text.p: European bunker prices were around $2 weaker on Tuesday as barges dipped, but ARA prices staged a modest recovery in the afternoon, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil traded at $111 fob in the morning as barge offers of $110 fob ARA drew no bids. However, traders said concerted action by a few barge players lifted prices by $2 to leave bunkers at $113, little down on Monday's levels. Some traders said the majors may additionally be holding back product.
"We saw reasonable but still relatively low bunker demand. The prices rose as barges were pushed up," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices were down about $2. The lower prices and subsequent rises in ARA encouraged buyers, leading to greater volumes than on Monday.
Bunkers in the Mediterranean were down $2 a tonne on average. Volumes in almost all ports was slack.
Further east, Egyptian and Fujairah fuel oil was also slightly weaker. Bunker volumes were slight with most players awaiting clearer signals from Singapore on Wednesday.
"It's a rather nervous market at the moment," one supplier said.
